text: 💡 You see it again in your mind: dusty-green diamond leaves with white mealy underside, grows in disturbed soil. Tamihana's words land on the memory like a label. Lamb's Quarters. Of course.

💡 The thorny bush with dark berries — THAT's what A woman, maybe 40s, with a gap-toothed grin was describing. Blackberry. It clicks like a key turning.
💡 The tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — THAT's what Jerome was describing. Hickory Nuts. It clicks like a key turning.

💡 Pawpaw. The small understory tree, big drooping leaves, mango-sized green-yellow fruit you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
💡 Learned: PARTY SYSTEM. You can invite people to travel and fight beside you. Ask — in conversation, like a person.
💡 Muscadine Grapes. The vine with thick-skinned round fruit you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunbasker: Never let it finish basking. Its scales go molten gold as it charges — hit it while it basks and the charge dies unspent — a stun, a shout, a thrown rock, anything that breaks its focus. Interruptible: the bask is a ritual, and rituals need quiet. Don't let it finish.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — White Noise: Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Grief Counselor: Sidestep the charge. Break line of sight during the mirror beat and the charge dies unspent — or sidestep: it can't turn mid-charge. Don't look at the reflection. Look at its feet — they tell you where it's going. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
